scenario: Response facts (LCRS.4.3.1) and `CallError` facts live in working memory once asserted, per LCRS.6.1; a rule matches them as it matches any fact. Pin: a standalone rule matching a service's response schema `Ack` (`ttl`, declaring `corr`, LCRS.4.3.2) on its correlation compiles cleanly. Path: `Ack` is an author-declared schema like any other, so resolution, validation and lowering treat the pattern as an ordinary one.
rules_ds:
schema Ack scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    ok: Bool

service svc.do:
    kwarg x: Int
    response Ack

rule handle_response:
    Ack r where r.corr == "my-call"
->
    log info "got response: {r.corr}"
